title: This merge proposal will update rust-seqouia-sq to version 1.4.0.
description:
This merge proposal will update rust-seqouia-sq to version 1.4.0.

## Packaging changes

* debian/control: Add Build-Depends-Arch libclang-dev. This is needed by the vendored "bindgen" crate which depends on "clang-sys".
* debian/watch: Fix Uversionmangle to include the pqc suffix. This prioritizes versions like 1.4.0 over 1.4.0-pqc.1, which is a pre-release.
* Drop patches:
  - relax-dep: Included in upstream's Cargo.toml.
  - rust-vendor/print-dh-cargo-built-using-bz2: Dependency is not included anymore.

## Notes

1.4.0 is not yet available on Debian so this makes us temporarily out-of-sync with debian/sid.
